sources.title: LAY'S Heartwork Microinfluencer Report - Heartwork Packs - 18.09.2020
sources.content:
LAY’S #HEARTWORK PACKS TO MICRO INFLUENCERS
1st July – 14th September 2020

THE BRIEF
Building on the connect formed with close to 1500 micro-influencers from the Smile campaign, LAY’S continued the trend by introducing LAY’S #Heartwork special packs to the extended LAY’S family securing reach, awareness, engagement and brand love.

Furthermore, the idea was to ensure every corner of India learnt of the LAY’S #Heartwork campaign through multiple social media posts that showered gratitude and drove donations for the unsung heroes of the country – farmers, truck drivers, retailers and many more.

OUR APPROACH
3 box & cotton pack types
Designing + printing
Buying lays packs
INR 20 pack
Special note as per pack type
Designing + printing
Corrugated box
To protect the box
Courier
All India Under Covid19 lockdown
Coordinating with the influencers
Calling to ensure messaging comes across

On connecting with the overall database of influencers we saw immense interest to participate in the campaign.
We connected with each of them individually and briefed them on the LAY’S #Heartwork Campaign and urged them to spread the word on their social media pages.

Alongside the outreach, we worked on preparing over 1000 LAY’S Heartwork boxes with customized letters and LAY’S Heartwork packs for each influencer, which was then shipped to their personal address amid a partial lockdown.
After the deliveries were made, we individually connected with each of them for feedback.

PHASE 1
1st July – 20th August
Total Packs Sent: 900
Promised Engagement: 700
Total Influencers engaged: 737
Posts Done: 587
Stories Done: 506

PHASE 2
20th August – 14th September
Total Packs Sent: 500
Promised Engagement: N/A
Total Influencers engaged: 321
Posts Done: 266
Stories Done: 379

TOTAL
Total Packs Sent: 1400
Total Influencers engaged: 1058
Posts Done: 853
Stories Done: 885

RESULTS
Tracked as per listening tool (excludes stories without hashtag/brand handle).
Reached out to 1400 influencers for the activity.
75% of the influencers organically posted on Instagram – 1058 influencers.
On an average each Influencer did 1 Instagram post & 3-4 Instagram stories.

CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE SUMMARY
ENGAGEMENT: 3.81 M
REACH: 4.76 M
MICRO INFLUENCERS: 1058 activated
POSTS/VIDEOS: 1738 (posts + stories)
Total Activity Duration: 1st July – 14th September 2020
Tracked as per listening tool (excludes stories without hashtag/brand handle).

CAMPAIGN PERCEIVED VALUE & COST SAVING
Perceived total amount: INR 1,58,72,000.
By doing Barter campaigns brand spent INR 14 Lakhs all inclusive.
Compared with the perceived value of INR 158 Lakhs.
Saving done by the brand: INR 1.44 Crore.

KEY LEARNINGS AND TAKEAWAYS
What Worked:
All influencers loved the campaign thought and appreciated how LAY’S urged other brands to thank the unsung heroes.
Influencers were elated to receive a repost from the brand handle.
Corrugated boxes helped provide extra protection during mass delivery.
Everyone followed the brief & tagged & thanked people personally as well.
Lot of fan engagement came and phase 2 was done out of sheer demand.

What Didn’t Work:
Influencers were slightly unclear about the cotton packs. Would recommend printing - DO NOT OPEN at the back of the pack.
Couriers were delayed under lockdown in certain areas.
Under COVID19 social distancing packaging teams had to work overtime.
Influencers who didn’t post wanted more than 1 pack of chips in the barter or wanted a payment for their post.

sources.title: Lay’s Heartwork x Reels Brief 22 July 2020
sources.content:
Lay’s Heartwork x Reels Brief | 22 July 2020

Idea
We launched our #Heartwork campaign to thank our unsung heroes such as farmers, factory workers, delivery people, shopkeepers and more who work tirelessly to bring us joy. We also thanked the Heartworkers of other brands on Twitter and Instagram, who are doing #Heartwork to make moments of joy possible.

Through Reels, we want people to express their gratitude towards the Heartworkers of their choice through our #Heartwork anthem. We’ll upload original music clips of our Heartwork anthem and #Heartwork stickers which will be used to create interesting content thanking the Heartworkers.

Mandates
Use campaign hashtags including #LaysIndia and #Heartwork and tag @lays_india.
Record performance in apparel matching the brand colour yellow.
Do not use hate symbols or political or religious references.
No competitor brand should be visible in frame.
Do not trivialize the contribution of those doing #Heartwork.
Choose one or more professions and thank their workers through the performance.

Creative Directions
The Heartwork Dance: enact actions of the Heartworker being thanked and include the heart symbol made with hands.
Lip Sync: expressive performance; additional actors may be used.
Acting It Out: a simple set thanking Heartworkers can be explored.
Creators were free to develop concepts as long as they followed the mandates.

reconciliationAuditResult.summary: The final ledger is conservative rather than publication-unsafe, but the reconciliation overstates an unproven story-metric conflict, conflates differently labelled influencer populations, and misses a percentage/count inconsistency. Three material warnings were identified.

findings.message: The reconciliation treats the three-to-four-story average and the reported story totals as necessarily sharing one denominator and measurement boundary. The supplied evidence expressly says listening-tool tracking excluded stories without a hashtag or brand handle, while the average is not stated as a tracked-only average. These figures may therefore coexist, and the reasoning that no tracking distinction was supplied is incorrect. This caused unnecessary withholding of the phase story counts, total story count, combined content total, and average claim.

The conflict group treats engaged influencers, organically posting influencers, and activated micro-influencers as one interchangeable denominator merely because each reported total is 1,058. Those labels represent potentially distinct scopes, and the evidence does not establish semantic identity. The independently supported phase engagement counts also sum exactly to the engagement total. Grouping and withholding all of these population metrics on the basis of the story-average issue is overbroad.

The reconciliation did not identify the internal arithmetic ambiguity between outreach to 1,400 influencers and the statement that 75% represented 1,058 influencers. The stated count is approximately 75.6% of 1,400, not exactly 75%, and would conventionally round to 76% at whole-percent precision. Because claim-022 is withheld, this omission is non-blocking, but the supplied reasoning identifies the wrong issue and leaves the actual percentage/count mismatch undocumented.

architecture.narrativeThesis: LAY’S #Heartwork paired a gratitude-led campaign idea with individualized influencer outreach and a demanding nationwide fulfilment operation during lockdown, generating documented social participation, reach and reported barter value at scale.
architecture.storyStrategy: Build the story around the activation’s operating system rather than forcing a generic challenge-to-outcome sequence. Open with the purpose and inherited influencer connection, reveal how personalized boxes, direct coordination and creator mandates turned that purpose into participation, then address the lockdown logistics and campaign friction candidly. Use the two documented phases to demonstrate expansion before closing with tracked performance and carefully framed barter economics. This makes the strongest supported story the combination of human intent, operational execution and measurable efficiency.

chapters.purpose: Explain the documented operating flow: preparing customized boxes and notes, shipping them to personal addresses, briefing influencers individually, requesting social sharing and following up for feedback.

chapters.purpose: Show how the campaign invited creators to thank selected professions through the anthem, hashtags and brand tag while offering dance, lip-sync, acting and creator-developed directions. chapters.purpose: Present nationwide packing, couriering and coordination as substantive campaign work, including delayed deliveries, overtime under social-distancing conditions and the documented reasons some influencers did not post.

chapters.purpose: Lay out the phase periods, pack distribution and post counts, while noting that the report attributes Phase 2 to demand. Keep outreach, packs and completed posts as distinct measures rather than implying a one-to-one relationship.

architecture.designRationale: A flexible render is preferable because the evidence supports several different storytelling modes: an opening campaign narrative, a process flow, creator-expression material, a candid logistics section, phase-by-phase charts and qualified economics. A generic Challenge–Insight–Idea–Execution–Outcome template would flatten the most distinctive evidence—the individualized fulfilment operation during lockdown—and could imply unsupported causal links between creator sentiment, demand, posting behavior and performance. The selected structure keeps outreach, boxes, packs, posts, reach, engagement and perceived value clearly separated, while excluding all low-confidence influencer and story metrics.

sections.heading: Gratitude for India’s unsung Heartworkers
sections.body: Running from 1 July to 14 September 2020, LAY’S #Heartwork set out to spread gratitude, encourage donations for unsung heroes and recognize groups including farmers, factory workers, delivery people and shopkeepers. The brief positioned the initiative as building on a connection formed with close to 1,500 micro-influencers through the earlier Smile campaign.

sections.heading: Individual outreach became a physical-to-social experience
sections.body: The operating flow combined customized campaign materials, delivery to personal addresses, individual briefing, a request to share the campaign socially and post-delivery feedback follow-up.

The team handled designing and printing, purchased LAY’S packs, prepared special notes and corrugated boxes, and coordinated deliveries across India. Influencers were contacted individually, briefed on LAY’S #Heartwork and urged to share the campaign on their social pages. After the boxes reached their personal addresses, the team followed up individually for feedback.

items.label: Customized Heartwork boxes prepared
items.note: Prepared with customized letters and LAY’S Heartwork packs for influencers.

sections.heading: Creative freedom within a clear gratitude mandate
sections.body: Creators were invited to thank Heartworkers of their choice through the #Heartwork anthem. The mandate required campaign hashtags, the @lays_india tag and a performance thanking workers from one or more selected professions, while leaving room for dance, lip-sync, acting and creator-developed concepts.

sections.heading: Professions placed at the heart of the campaign

sections.body: Original anthem clips and #Heartwork stickers were planned to support content creation, while the campaign also thanked the Heartworkers of other brands on Twitter and Instagram. The report characterized influencers as loving the campaign thought and appreciating LAY’S call for other brands to thank unsung heroes. It also said influencers were elated to receive reposts from the brand handle.

sections.heading: The hidden lockdown operation
sections.body: Nationwide packing, couriering and individual coordination continued under partial-lockdown and social-distancing conditions, making fulfilment a substantive part of the activation.

Boxes were shipped to influencers’ personal addresses across India amid a partial lockdown. The report records courier delays in certain areas and says packaging teams worked overtime while observing COVID-19 social distancing. It also states that influencers who did not post wanted either more than one pack of chips in the barter or payment for their post.

sections.body: The report says Phase 2 was undertaken because of demand. The phase figures keep packs distributed, posts completed and influencers reached out to as separate measures.

It follows the approved architecture, preserves distinctions among outreach, boxes, packs, posts, reach and engagement, includes the listening-tool limitation, qualifies the barter economics appropriately, and does not materially overstate causality, continuity or outcomes.
